rationale: After 71 minutes in the position, price has failed to follow through toward the $14.32 target and has now slipped below the 5-minute 9-EMA ($13.96) on severely drying 1-minute volume (~2k-3k shares per bar). With the upside momentum stalled and only 70 minutes remaining in the session, closing locks in the small gain rather than holding a stagnant setup into the final hour. Flipping to short is unwarranted given the strong broader market (SPY +2.48%) and price remaining above session VWAP ($13.85).
